description: Coaching/decision BAS is highly confounded and cannot attribute raw residuals to one coach without controls.

title: Collapse BAS is isolated live-replay research
description: Collapse candidate requires chronological live replay and cannot enter the same-game pregame row.

title: BAS components need not be additive unless score architecture guarantees it
description: Do not force component residuals to sum to headline margin residual unless W16 coherent score architecture establishes that identity.

title: BAS probability calibration is a protected later test
description: Later BAS probability models require proper scoring/reliability/calibration evaluation.

title: BAS severity probabilities must be monotone
description: Require P>=21 <= P>=14 <= P>=7 <= P>=3 for coherent severity probabilities.

title: Sensitivity anchors cannot silently redefine primary BAS
description: Market/selected-forecast sensitivity anchors remain explicitly separate label/evaluation versions.

title: Null/no-excess BAS result must be published honestly
description: If protected evidence does not support stable A&M excess, report that result rather than mining secondary analyses.

title: Fan narrative cannot determine BAS labels/features
description: Battered Aggie folklore, 12th Man narratives and anecdotal collapse weights are not ground truth.

title: No W15 empirical BAS claims
description: W15 may not claim Aggie Excess, significance, calibration, component winner or historical effect size.

title: Repair W15/W16 future-wave dependency inversion
description: TASK-101/TASK-116 may not depend on future W17 TASK-040; W17 retains empirical baseline/promotion ownership.

title: W16 starts from frozen BAS label contract
description: TASK-116 may begin after W14 specialization and W15 label gates without pretending W17 empirical evaluation is complete.

title: Coherent joint predictive distribution
description: Score/margin/win outputs must originate from or reconcile exactly to one coherent predictive distribution.

title: Final score labels are authoritative

title: Margin derives from scores
description: Historical and forecast margin semantics must equal team score minus opponent score.

title: Win/loss derives coherently
description: Win/loss labels/probabilities must agree with final/joint score distribution and explicit overtime resolution.

title: Overtime/tie handling explicit

title: Probability mass normalizes

title: Score support nonnegative integer

title: Expected outputs agree with distribution

title: BAS target semantics remain W15-frozen
description: W16 cannot redefine performance residual or 3/7/14/21 BAS label thresholds.

title: BAS severity probabilities nested
description: Any BAS severity probability output must satisfy P21<=P14<=P7<=P3.

title: BAS scientific anchor remains independent
description: BAS probability/label interfaces retain the BAS-independent national pregame expectation anchor where required.

title: Strong simple baselines mandatory
description: Elo/logistic/simple coherent score baselines must remain challengers/reference points even when advanced models are tested.

title: No complex-model superiority assumption
description: Boosted/neural/ensemble/joint-complexity candidates require protected evidence before promotion.

title: Joint-score families remain candidates
description: Poisson/bivariate/overdispersed/structured/copula/mixture families remain candidates until chronological evaluation.

title: Boosted-tree library not frozen
description: XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost are candidate implementations; exact library is not a W16 invariant.

title: Neural model remains challenger
description: Small PyTorch tabular/distributional models are optional challengers and must earn value over simpler baselines.

title: Pure-football lane excludes market
description: Pure-football features/training/inference may not use betting-market observations or derived market consensus.

title: Market-augmented lane is PIT-safe

title: Closing market cannot leak earlier
description: Closing lines are unavailable to earlier forecasts and may be retrospective benchmarks only when timestamp semantics are explicit.

title: Market source lineage required
description: Market outputs retain provider, market, value/side/price and temporal/source lineage.

title: Scenario engine uses immutable baseline

title: Scenario overrides remain PIT-safe
description: Player/weather/other scenario evidence must obey prediction-time eligibility.

title: Scenario mixture weights explicit
description: Scenario mixture weights must be explicit, nonnegative and normalized.

title: Simulation reproducibility
description: Stochastic simulation records model/data/scenario lineage, random seed and sample configuration.

title: Player availability scenarios use W12 state
description: Player scenarios use availability/effectiveness/usage/replacement contracts rather than fixed injury point penalties.

title: Weather scenarios use issued forecasts
description: Weather scenarios use historically issued/PIT-safe forecast runs rather than observed-weather hindsight.

title: Uncertainty classes stay distinct
description: Aleatoric, epistemic, data, availability, weather, opponent, regime, specialization and disagreement signals may not be blindly summed.

title: OOD warning does not choose winner
description: OOD normally widens uncertainty/warning state and does not automatically favor either team.

title: OOD threshold remains evidence-owned
description: W16 does not freeze a numeric OOD trigger; W17 precommits evidence-based policy.

title: Model-disagreement threshold remains evidence-owned
description: W16 does not freeze a numeric model-disagreement warning threshold.

title: Correlated models are not independent votes
description: Ensemble disagreement interpretation accounts for shared training data/features/model correlation.

title: A&M no-adjustment baseline retained
description: Every A&M specialization comparison retains national no-adjustment prediction as a valid fallback.

title: A&M specialized output remains coherent

description: Protected splits/metrics/decision rules are frozen before protected result inspection.

title: Development tuning stops before 2024 protected holdout

title: 2026+ forward shadow holdout

title: Nested development tuning remains chronological

title: Calibration evaluated separately from discrimination

description: Each study declares bounded trial count, concurrency, and resource limits before execution.

title: Pruned and failed HPO trials are retained
description: Search history includes pruned and failed trials rather than retaining only winners.

title: Distributed/NFS HPO cannot rely on shared SQLite
description: SQLite is not accepted as the distributed/network-filesystem HPO coordination backend.

title: HPO paid compute is disabled without explicit approval
description: Remote paid trial execution requires explicit user authorization.

title: HPO tool is replaceable and not governance truth
description: Optuna may implement search but canonical study/experiment lineage remains tool-neutral.

title: MLflow is a replaceable tracking adapter
description: MLflow run IDs and registry state do not replace canonical Aggie experiment IDs or W17 promotion authority.

title: Hypothesis lifecycle is explicit and append only
description: Hypotheses move through proposed/triaged/approved/testing/outcome states with retained prior history.

title: Hypotheses require disconfirming evidence criteria
description: Approved hypotheses state what evidence would falsify or fail to support the proposed mechanism.

title: Experiment queue deduplicates exact identities
description: Exact duplicate experiment identities are rejected/linked before redundant execution.

title: Infrastructure failure is distinct from scientific rejection
description: Queue/result semantics distinguish runtime/data/governance failures from empirical rejection.

title: Worktree or immutable source snapshot isolation is required
description: Code-changing experiments execute in a dedicated worktree or verified immutable source snapshot.

title: Experiment workers cannot mutate protected W17 paths
description: Worktree mutation scope rejects protected split/metric/threshold/promotion files.

title: Experiment resource budget is explicit
description: CPU, RAM, GPU/VRAM, disk/artifact, trial and concurrency budgets are declared before execution.

title: Experiment artifact manifest is mandatory
description: Each attempt records content hashes, sizes, classes, storage locations, producer, and sensitivity metadata.

title: Large model/data artifacts stay outside cumulative ZIP
description: Repository stores manifests/lineage rather than large experiment binaries or datasets.

title: Replay failure taxonomy is explicit
description: Hash/input/environment/output/artifact/rule-seal mismatches are distinct non-silent outcomes.

title: Challenger adoption requires replay verification
description: A candidate cannot be adopted as challenger when required replay is missing or mismatched.

title: Result comparison requires semantic compatibility
description: Direct rankings require compatible target, split, data, metric, lane, BAS anchor, and A&M baseline semantics.

title: Negative experiment results are first-class evidence
description: Rejected/dominated/inconclusive results remain searchable and linked to parent/child experiments.

title: Corrected W18 must cover every master W18 design item
description: A machine-readable coverage matrix maps every Wave 18 master requirement to artifacts/reference implementation.

title: Corrected W18 supersedes the thin W18 draft
description: The corrected W18 pair is the only valid W19 parent; earlier W18 draft hashes are explicitly superseded.

title: Corrected W18 preserves exact W17 parent contents
description: Every W17 cumulative member remains present in corrected W18 with no accidental deletion.

title: Corrected W18 gate requires tournament/HPO/replay tests
description: Wave completion requires dedicated automated tests for tournament, HPO, replay, worktree, artifacts, queue, and seal behavior.

title: Canonical local experiment metadata store is transactional
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Experiment specs, queue events, result packets, artifact records and replay reports are persisted transactionally in a local reference store without making the store a distributed coordination service.

title: Queue event history is append-only and hash chained
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Queue events use contiguous indexes and previous-event hashes so a worker or UI cannot silently rewrite experiment history.

title: Operational retry and scientific child experiment are distinct
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Retries with unchanged scientific identity create new attempts; feature/model/data/config changes create explicit child experiments.

title: Research scheduler enforces bounded resource admission
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: CPU, RAM, GPU/VRAM, disk, paid-compute authorization, dependency readiness and shared-contract conflicts are checked before execution.

title: Worktree/shared-contract locks are explicit
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Parallel research uses explicit locks for shared contracts and cannot treat idle compute as permission to mutate protected/shared surfaces.

title: Result comparison requires semantic compatibility
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Direct comparison requires compatible target, development split, data snapshot, feature version, metric registry, model lane and relevant BAS/A&M semantics.

title: Multi-metric comparison preserves Pareto/non-scalar evidence
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Research ranking may use a primary metric but retains calibration, subgroup, coherence, resource and secondary-metric evidence rather than hiding tradeoffs in one arbitrary composite.

title: Experiment artifact classes and repository boundary are explicit
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Large model/data/checkpoint artifacts remain outside cumulative ZIP while manifests/hashes/URIs and allowed small evidence artifacts remain in the repo.

title: Research result packets exclude protected feedback
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Protected holdout/forward-shadow metrics and champion decisions cannot appear in research-plane result packets or HPO objectives.

title: Replay tolerance is precommitted
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Stochastic replay tolerances are declared before replay results are observed; deterministic stages require exact or declared-normalized equivalence.

title: Experiment metadata store has integrity/backup contract
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Local experiment-store integrity can be checked and backed up without replacing canonical repository governance or large artifact storage.

title: Dependency-free local tracking fallback exists
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: A local append-only JSONL tracker can preserve canonical research events when MLflow is unavailable.

title: MLflow registry/run state is non-authoritative
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: External MLflow run/registry states cannot replace Aggie experiment IDs, judging seals, acceptance controls or champion/promotion authority.

title: Optuna studies export canonical Aggie evidence
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Optuna trial/study identities are external references and trial parameters/results must be exportable into canonical Aggie experiment/study evidence.

title: Nested search multiplicity is retained
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Outer feature/model/search variants and inner HPO trials are all counted/linked so selection multiplicity is not hidden.

title: Research proposal deduplication checks negative history
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Automation queries rejected/failed lineage before repeating an identical or materially similar dead-end experiment.

title: Scientific rejection is separated from operational failure
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: OOM/timeouts/data/rights/governance failures cannot be interpreted as scientific evidence that a hypothesis is false.

title: Worktree cleanup cannot delete required evidence lineage
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Deleting an experiment worktree is allowed only after required config/result/artifact/replay evidence is persisted elsewhere.

title: W18 full gate requires executable subsystem tests
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Wave completion requires executable tests for store, queue, resource scheduler, tournaments, HPO, replay, artifact policy, locks, promotion bridge and challenger admission.

title: W18 full rebuild supersedes all earlier W18 draft pairs
source_basis: W18 full-rebuild audit and master Wave 18 experimentation requirements
description: Only the final full-rebuild cumulative/hydration pair may be used as W19 parent; earlier W18 draft and corrected-draft hashes are superseded.

title: Raw snapshot identity is content-addressed
description: Starter raw snapshots preserve exact bytes and SHA-256-derived immutable IDs.

title: Entity resolution fails closed on unknown or ambiguous aliases
description: Unknown or ambiguous source entities are not silently auto-linked.

title: Feature factory consumes PIT state only
description: Starter feature construction receives W08-eligible PIT state and does not query mutable source data directly.

title: Derived starter artifacts retain deterministic lineage
description: PIT state and feature artifacts link to exact parent observations and transforms.

title: W19 foundation gate requires executable end-to-end starter tests
description: W19 completes only when raw snapshot, resolution, PIT exclusion and feature lineage tests pass.

title: Model predictions consume immutable PIT-safe feature lineage
description: Every W20 starter prediction binds to a W19 feature snapshot, forecast cutoff, training cutoff and lineage refs.

title: Published starter forecast summaries derive from one coherent joint score distribution
description: Win/loss, expected scores, margin and BAS distribution-derived probabilities cannot contradict the stored joint distribution.

title: Boosting remains an optional injected backend
description: Base installation remains dependency-light; a boosting runtime requires an explicit supported backend/predictor and does not imply a selected winner.

title: Calibration parameters remain development-only until protected evaluation
description: W20 calibrators may be parameterized from development evidence only and never fit or selected from protected outcomes.

title: Model registry cannot self-promote W20 artifacts
description: Starter model registry permits candidate/development/protected-ready/rejected/inconclusive states but not autonomous promotion.

title: A&M specialization retains explicit national no-adjustment reference
description: Every A&M starter specialization adapter retains the national forecast reference and may validly use zero adjustment.

title: BAS starter forecasts preserve protected anchor lineage and severity nesting
description: BAS >=3/>=7/>=14/>=21 probabilities are nested and linked to model/anchor evidence without significance claims.

title: W20 integration gate requires executable model calibration A&M and BAS tests
description: Wave 20 completes only when runtime, baselines, joint score, calibration, ensemble, registry, A&M, BAS and lineage tests pass.

title: W21 weekly workflow is resumable and idempotent
description: A weekly run has immutable identity, durable per-step checkpoints, and does not repeat successful steps when replayed with the same identity.

title: QA quarantine blocks downstream mutation
description: A quarantined/failed validation result terminates the current run before PIT state, features, training, promotion or publication.

title: Orchestration backend remains replaceable and local-first
description: The functional starter uses a dependency-free durable local orchestrator behind explicit step contracts; Prefect remains optional pending operational evidence.

title: Promotion consumes protected external decision evidence only
description: Weekly MLOps cannot infer champion status from development results; it may apply only a W17-governed promotion decision carrying judging-rule and protected-evidence hashes.

title: Champion history and rollback are immutable and auditable
description: Champion changes append immutable decision history and rollback records while the current pointer is updated atomically.

title: Forecast publication is immutable and lineage bound
description: Published forecast snapshots bind cutoff, model artifact, feature snapshot and lineage; a reused snapshot ID cannot overwrite different content.

title: Postmortems append evidence and only propose research
description: Completed-game scoring/postmortems append evidence and may enqueue experiment proposals but cannot rewrite historical forecasts, judging rules, features or champions.

title: W21 integration gate requires full weekly workflow replay evidence
description: Wave 21 completes only when orchestration, idempotency, quarantine/failure behavior, governed promotion, rollback, immutable publication and postmortem tests pass.

title: Serving is immutable-snapshot-only
description: API/dashboard request paths read published forecast artifacts only and cannot invoke ingestion, PIT building, feature construction, training, calibration fitting, protected evaluation or model inference.

title: Forecast API is versioned and market-lane explicit
description: API responses have an explicit version and preserve PURE_FOOTBALL versus MARKET_AUGMENTED lanes without silently substituting one for the other.

title: Freshness is explicit without fabricated SLA
description: Serving exposes cutoff/published/serve times and exact age; without an operations-frozen THR-010 it must not label a forecast current, and configured stale states are visible.

title: Forecast product exposes uncertainty BAS availability matchup and analog context
description: Published product views expose uncertainty, BAS severity, availability, matchup drivers, historical analogs, warnings and comparison context when those fields exist in the immutable snapshot.

title: Serving explanations are precomputed and non-causal
description: Serving renders only precomputed explanation/analog evidence and labels it associational/model evidence; it does not run SHAP/models or imply causal certainty in request paths.

title: User-facing lineage spans model feature data and sources
description: Forecast responses expose model artifact hash, feature snapshot identity, data snapshot references, source metadata and immutable lineage references.

title: FastAPI is optional adapter over dependency-free serving core
description: Use framework-neutral core services with an optional FastAPI/static-dashboard adapter; Streamlit/React remain replaceable alternatives and base dependencies remain empty.

title: W22 product gate requires executable snapshot-boundary tests
description: Wave 22 completes only when backward snapshot parsing, PIT/as-of serving, lane separation, freshness, explanation/lineage surfaces and forbidden-serving-import tests pass.

title: W23 CI covers core and optional product surfaces
description: CI runs the dependency-free core on Windows/Linux Python 3.12 and separately exercises the exact-pinned optional product adapter without weakening snapshot-only serving.

title: Operational telemetry is structured and secret-safe
description: Operational logs/metrics use structured identifiers and redaction; arbitrary environment variables or restricted raw source payloads are not emitted.

title: Runtime environment evidence is captured
description: Runtime Python/platform/package versions and a safe environment allowlist are captured in a hashable manifest for training/evaluation/forecast operational evidence.

title: Target-hardware budgets require an actual target match
description: THR-011/THR-012 cannot be frozen from CI/container/smoke measurements; authoritative evidence requires the representative benchmark on the declared Windows/Ryzen/32GB/RTX5060 target class.

title: Backup restore is content-verified and path-safe
description: Operational backup manifests hash every payload member; restore verifies coverage/hashes and rejects unsafe archive paths before materialization.

title: Immutable histories are excluded from automatic retention deletion
description: Governance history, published forecasts and champion/rollback histories are not automatically pruned; transient caches remain separately classed.

title: W23 production gate fails honest when target benchmark is absent
description: Wave 23 may package an implementation-complete checkpoint but must not clear TASK-163 or advance to W24 while authoritative target-hardware benchmark evidence is absent.

title: User-directed W24 sequencing override does not clear W23 evidence blocker
source_basis: latest explicit user instruction + source-of-truth precedence
description: Wave 24 may execute under the explicit user instruction while TASK-161/TASK-163 and AC-038 remain unresolved; the override changes sequencing only, not evidence status.

title: W24 synthetic E2E spans implemented starter boundaries
description: A synthetic contract-integration battery must exercise source adapter, immutable raw snapshot, entity resolution, PIT, features, model runtime, coherent forecast/BAS, immutable publication and snapshot-only serving.

title: Replay readiness cannot be reported as empirical historical replay
description: Deterministic synthetic replay may establish interface readiness but cannot claim real historical replay, protected metrics or model-quality evidence until materialized PIT history is replayed chronologically.

title: Target game output is explicitly banned from its own pregame state
description: HISTORICAL_GAME_OUTPUT whose game_id equals ForecastCutoff.target_game_id must be rejected even if malformed timestamps would otherwise make it appear eligible.

title: W24 source refresh records current deltas against W06
description: The second source-landscape pass records current checked surfaces, changes, access/provenance implications and remaining gaps without claiming exhaustive internet coverage.

title: Shared-upstream SportsDataverse layers are not independent corroboration
description: cfbfastR-cfb-raw is modeled as upstream provenance for cfbfastR-cfb-data; sibling/derived layers sharing ESPN upstream evidence may not be counted as independent corroborating sources.

title: Weather access lane and ensemble historical depth are explicit
description: Weather provenance records access mode and run semantics; ensemble mean/spread is optional research with shallow historical depth and is not a mandatory long-history feature.

title: W24 final architecture challenge classifies major decisions
description: Major architecture decisions are explicitly classified KEEP, REVISE, DEFER or REJECT before Wave 25; functioning architecture is not redesigned without material evidence.

title: W25 carries unresolved AC-038 target-hardware evidence if still absent
source_basis: W23 blocker + W24 explicit sequencing override
description: If target-hardware benchmark evidence remains absent at final consolidation, W25 must list AC-038/THR-011/THR-012 as unresolved and must not claim fully cleared local-production readiness.
